basic_info_description:
Private Single-Family Home with Garage & Views | Castro/Eureka Valley

Experience true San Francisco living in this completely detached, private single-family home offering stunning downtown views and total independence. This standalone house provides exceptional privacy with no shared walls and its own attached garage with laundry - a rare find in the city!

There is no yard but steps away from Kite Hill. 

PRIVACY & SETTING:
- Fully detached single-family home - no neighbors above or below
- Peaceful setting with scenic San Francisco topography views along one side
- Stunning views of San Francisco's iconic topography - watch the city cascade down the hillsides beneath Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower
- Completely private with no shared walls
- Serene, quiet location
- Abundant street parking available

RECENT UPDATES:
- Modern kitchen featuring new quartz countertops, expanded layout, standard-size dishwasher, and new sink/faucet
- Fully refreshed bathroom with new vanity, sink, hardware, shower fixtures, and tile flooring
- Refinished hardwood floors throughout
- Fresh paint and updated lighting
- New matching hardware and electrical upgrades

AMENITIES:
- Attached garage with washer/dryer
- Panoramic SF views from kitchen, bedroom, and living room
- Bright, open living space with modern lighting
- Spacious kitchen with dining nook overlooking the city
- Excellent storage space
- Private entrance

LOCATION:
- Walking distance to Castro's restaurants, shops, and entertainment
- Easy access to public transportation
- Quiet, secluded neighborhood
- Minutes to tech shuttles, MUNI, and major commute routes

This thoughtfully renovated home offers the privacy of single-family living with all the conveniences of city life.

Water and garbage covered. Tenant is responsible for gas and electric.
